tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password Hashing Policy

This project's current recorded decision is to hash passwords with argon2id, chosen because it is much harder to crack than the algorithm it replaced.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
tool_input.description: Create the password hashing policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is to hash passwords with argon2id, because it is much harder to crack than the algorithm it replaced.

The record behind it is Muninn decision #11, which the user stated directly. Nothing later retires it. The only later withdrawal, #25, is about certificate verification on dev builds. The file doesn't name the replaced algorithm.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error. The file was created on the second attempt, with the Write tool.

Muninn's heartbeat also flagged 20 hook runs that started and never finished, which suggests a hook is timing out. It doesn't affect this file. The log is at `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` if you want to look.
